name: Session Archive
description: Background TTL sweep that archives generated sessions (cron, subagent, isolated) and renames their transcripts into upstream-recognized archive artifacts.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Master switch for the archive sweep.

ttl.label: Session TTL
ttl.help: Idle age before a generated session is archived (duration string, default unit minutes; default 60m).

targets.label: Targets
targets.help: Generated-session classes to archive (default: cron, subagent, isolated).

isolatedKeyPrefixes.label: Isolated key prefixes
isolatedKeyPrefixes.help: Additional session-key prefixes classified as isolated ("isolated:" and exact "isolated" are built in).

archiveTranscripts.label: Archive transcripts
archiveTranscripts.help: Rename pruned transcripts to <file>.deleted.<timestamp> inside the store directory (default: true).

intervalMs.label: Sweep timer (ms)
intervalMs.help: Service timer cadence (default 60000; a 5-minute per-store gap throttles effective sweeps).
